description: Check a signature request BEFORE signing it: decodes EIP-712 typed data (ERC-20 permit, Permit2, Seaport order, transfer authorization) or an x402 payment request, explains in one sentence what signing would allow, screens spenders and payees for sanctions and scams, and catches signature-drainer patterns. Returns proceed / caution / avoid. Free over MCP for 10 calls per day; beyond that the tool returns the pay-per-call x402 endpoint and its price.

expectedMaxUsd.description: x402 only: refuse payment options above this many USD

paymentRequired.description: x402 PaymentRequired object with accepts[] the agent is about to pay

typedData.description: EIP-712 typed data { domain, types, primaryType, message }, or its JSON string

name: signature_check
